purpose: Controller review remediation diagnostics, not policy selection or reserved evaluation
audit_states: common LQR rollouts; all candidates maintain independent shadow gate state every tick; audit nominal/tire/low-friction/sensor regions, fresh packet each tick
realized_cost: paired cloned true plant, actual hidden mu/stiffness only inside offline plant; same 50ms command hold then nominal true-state tracking LQR continuation; 200ms total, same cost terms as gate with evolving reference curvature
classification: helpful if J_LQR-J_candidate > max(1e-7,0.01*J_LQR); harmful if opposite exceeds same tolerance; otherwise neutral. Eligible false rejection excludes age/envelope/persistence safety rejection. All reasons separately reported. Test all three gate-allowed ramp weights at each sampled state, not a tuned candidate sign.
training: No new research policy training in this diagnostic; execution-state interface tested separately. No full campaign or final reserved evaluation.
decision: No gate threshold or policy changes based on these results. Report every baseline, failures, seed means, predicted-vs-realized deltas. Observational diagnosis is not proof of optimality or real-world safety.
lqr_configuration: comparison.configure_lqr() uses frozen comparison-protocol.json; all 72 LQR cells must exactly reproduce revision4 rows
